text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Nanaka stands upon a volcanic mountain,
a complex expression on her face.
text_block_list.orig_text: 一人、物憂げな表情で火山に立つナナカ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh...
I just can't seem to get over how I failed last time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーむ……
どうもこの前の事件以降テンションがあがらないでござる。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Ooh! This is a limited edition item!
Uhhhh... It can wait for another time, I guess.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
おー、
これは限定品ではないかー
……うーん……
まあ、
いいや今度で。

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text: Hey there, missy! J-just who I was hoping to see!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーいお嬢ちゃん！　
ちょ、
ちょうどいいところに！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're... the merchants from the other day?
Hey again! What's up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
おじさんたちこの間の商人さん？
おつおつー、
どしたのー？

text_block_list.name: Merchant 2
text_block_list.text:
I-it's terrible!
Those nasty mages you captured have escaped from jail!
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
大変なんだ！　
この前君が捕まえてくれた
魔法使いたちが脱獄しちまって……！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text:
A-and worse, they actually attacked us again
and stole our valuable spellbook!
text_block_list.orig_text:
し、
しかも、
あろうことかまた俺たちを襲って
魔導書を奪っていったんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Uwehh?! Th-that same pair of goons?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うえー！？　
あ、
あの二人が！？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
This is... not a good turn of events,
but it could be my chance to avenge {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは……
おじさんたちには悪いけど、
{0}君の仇を取るチャンス……？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: I... I'll get your spellbook back, so you just wait right here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
魔導書は取り返してくるから、
おじさんたちはここで待ってて！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Wait, missy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
おい！　
お嬢ちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: I followed their magical signature, and it led me here, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
強い魔力の痕跡を追ったら、
ここにたどり着いたけど……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Aahhh...Why do I keep thinking about {0}?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
こんな時まで{0}君のこと
考えちゃうなんてぇぇ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
I don't want him to get hurt again, though...
Coming without him was the right decision!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
また傷つけちゃったら嫌だし……
置いてきて正解だよね……

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text: Ugh, this has been a real ordeal.
text_block_list.orig_text: ったく散々な目にあったぜ。

text_block_list.name: Mage 2
text_block_list.text:
But hey, we did get what we came for in the end,
so it's all good.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあでも、
遠回りにはなったが目的のものも手に入ったし、
よかったことにしようや。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Found 'em. All right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いた……
よしっ。

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text:
There's nobody here but us,
so we can finally test this spellbook properly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
邪魔の入らないここなら、
魔導書の力を思いきり試せるな。

text_block_list.name: Mage 2
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Let's begin.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
始めるぞ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: You really think I'd allow that?!
text_block_list.orig_text: そうはさせるかっての！

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text: Wha—?! The book...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ！？　
本が……！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Hahah! One spellbook, successfully retrieved!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふーん！　
魔導書、
奪還成功なり！

text_block_list.name: Mage 2
text_block_list.text:
You! Why are you here?!
We had to suffer jailtime thanks to your interfering!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前！　
また邪魔をっ！
お前のせいでこっちは牢屋生活だったんだからなあ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! And that's exactly what you two deserve!
I'll send you back there in a jiffy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっへーん、
君たちにはそれがお似合いだよん♪
またすぐ牢屋に戻してやるんだから！

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text:
You're going to regret messing with us...
Prepare yourself, \"magical girl\"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
首を突っ込んできたこと、
後悔させてやる……
覚悟しやがれ魔法少女ぉ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I like that! You're such perfect villains!
However! Did you forget? I've got the spellbook!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいねいいねー！　
悪役感ハンパない！
だが！　
今の私には、
この魔導書がある！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
You don't mind if I try out... this ultra-rare spell, do you?!
I'll use it to defeat you both! Haaahhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おじさんたち、
使わせてもらうよ超絶レア魔法！
こいつで成敗してくれようぞ！　
はぁぁぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm? Did I bungle it? One more time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん？　
失敗かな。
もういっちょ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁぁぁぁぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, why isn't it working?!
Fatal comprehension error!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょちょちょちょ、
なんで使えないの！？
理解不能！　理解不能！

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text:
Hahah... Ahahahah! Too bad for you!
That magic spell needs two people to perform the incantation!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はは、
あーはっはっは！　
残念だったなあ！
その魔法はな、
二人で詠唱しないと発動しないんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Mage 2
text_block_list.text:
It's a unique form of magic fueled by bonds of trust!
That's why this spellbook is considered so remarkable!
text_block_list.orig_text:
唱える二人に『信頼関係』が必要な特殊な呪文……
それがこの魔導書が貴重品として扱われる由縁なのさ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: No... It can't be...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なん……
だと！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Or that would be the classic reaction, but the great Magical Girl Nanaka
doesn't need a spellbook to whoop your butts! No problemo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とか言ってみるけどー、
別に魔法少女ナナカちゃんとしては
この魔導書がなくてもぐうかわサイツヨだし！　
モーマンタイ！

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text: What an irritating brat... Hrgghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
口が減らねえ女だ……
おらっ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
O-ouchie! You really do have some nasty spells...
But I ain't about to lose! It's my turn now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっ！　たぁ……
やっぱり強力だね君たちの魔法……
でもオイラ負けないよ？　
私の、
ターン！

text_block_list.name: Mage 2
text_block_list.text: I don't think so!
text_block_list.orig_text: まだまだー！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I guess real life doesn't work like turn-based battles...
But who cares! I can block this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっ！　
やっぱ現実はターン制バトルのようにはいかないかー！
このくらい、
防いでみせる……！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
 Urghh... F-fighting one-on-two... is pretty... tough...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
くうっ……
ふ、
二人いっぺんは……
やっぱり……
きつい……！

text_block_list.name: Mage 2
text_block_list.text:
What's this? You're weaker than last time!
Is this really all you've got?! Here, eat this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだなんだぁ、
前回より歯ごたえがねーなー
お前の力はそんなもんかよ！　
おら、
吹っ飛べ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Guaaahhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ、
ああああああ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Urgh...! But... why?!
Last time, I was a match for them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！　
なん……
で！
この前は、
互角くらいだったのに！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Ah...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……あっ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Of course! I forgot about your ability!
Wooo! This feels like... a power rush!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ！　
そうか！　
君の力があった！
……ひょー！　
こ、
れ、
は！　
なんかキター！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
You're on support duty, 'kay?
I'll take the front lines!
text_block_list.orig_text:
君はサポートをよろしく！
私が前衛に立つから！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
{0}, back me up!
I'm gonna go all out! Take this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君、
サポートよろしく！
こっちもいっくよー！　
そいや！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Of course...
Against the thief, and the monster, and these guys...
I only ever won because he was with me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はは、
そっか……
ひったくりの時も、
魔物の時も、
この前も……
彼がいたから、
私は戦えてたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: All this time, I was just relying on his strength...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君に、
ずっと……
支え続けてもらって……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
But I forgot that... Tried to go it alone...
What kind of a magical girl am I?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それを忘れて、
一人で突っ走って……
なにが、
なにが魔法少女だ……

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text: This is where it ends. So long, \"magical girl\"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで、
終わりだ……
あばよ、
魔法少女！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... So Magical Girl Nanaka is getting cancelled mid-run.
I just wish...I could see him... one... last...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
魔法少女ナナカ、
これで打ち切り……
かな。
最後に、
もう一度……
彼、に……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Wh... what?

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Huh...? This voice...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
この声……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: No way... But why?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うそ……
なんで……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: What are... you doing here, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうして……
{0}君がここに……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
I see... Those merchant guys
told you about the situation too, huh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか、
商人のおじさんたち、
{0}君にも事情を話してたんだね……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: But how did you find this place?
choice_data_list: I saw your magic light up the sky.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
なんでこの場所が……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: No way... You're kidding me... Ha... haha...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな……
そんなことって……
ふ……
ふふ……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Aha... ahahahahah! Ahahahahah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは、
あはははは！　
あはははは！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
It's perfect! The classic climax!
Just when all seems lost, the magical girl's friend arrives!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さいっこー！　
この王道展開！
ピンチに陥った魔法少女のもとに仲間が駆け付ける！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I got to live through this moment!
Hyahhh! My hype is through the roof!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなに燃える展開が私に訪れるとは！
くはー！　
昂ぶってきたー！

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text: Tch... Another pest to deal with.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ッチ！　
邪魔者が増えやがった。

text_block_list.name: Mage 2
text_block_list.text:
Oh, who cares? We know that guy's weak as hell.
If we attack 'em both, they'll go down in—
text_block_list.orig_text:
問題ねえ……
あの男はたいしたことなかったんだ。
二人で集中狙いすりゃあ簡単に──

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
You sure about that?!
It's time I showed you... the power of our friendship!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはどうかな！
……見してあげるよ……
私たち二人の力！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, {0}... Could you try reciting
the incantation in here with me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、{0}君、
この魔導書の呪文、
私と一緒に唱えてほしいんだ……

text_block_list.name: Mage 2
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Of all the ridiculous ideas!
You really think the two of you can use that?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！　
なにを言いだすかと思えば！
お前らにその呪文が使えるとは──

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
I'll channel the magic for both of us!
So... you just believe in me and say the words!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私が二人分の魔力を使う！
だから……
君は私を信じて呪文を唱えて……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Just like I believe in you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も、
君を信じてるから……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Here goes!
This is my... No, this is [i]our[/i] magical girl power!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いくよ……
……私が……
いや、
私たちが……
魔法少女だー！！

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text: Ugh! L-let's block it with our own magic!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ！　
お、俺たちも魔法で防ぐぞ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Eat thiiiiiis!
text_block_list.orig_text: いっけぇぇぇぇぇぇ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Sol Diana!
text_block_list.orig_text: ソル・ディアーナ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa?!
Wh-what's this?! Such strength! Definitely OP!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふおおおお！？
な、
なにこれ！　
つおい！　
絶対つおい！

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text: I-it's no good... I can't block... it all...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
ダメだ……
防ぎきれ……
ねぇ……っ！

text_block_list.name: Mage 1 & 2
text_block_list.text: Aaaghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ギャー！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: *pant*... W-we got 'em... right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁはぁ……
や、
やった……
のかな？

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text: I can't... lose now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……こんな……
ところで。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Aaagh! What a toughie!
Couldn't he just conk out like his partner?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわー……
しぶとい……
相方さんはバタンキューしてるのに。

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text:
This can't... Urgh!
W-we must join our master in... the Twilight City...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんな……
ぐっ！
……お、
俺たちは、
あの方と……
『黄昏の都』に……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Twilight City?!
Wh-where did that name come from?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
黄昏の都！？
な、
なんでその名前を！？

text_block_list.name: Mage 1
text_block_list.text: My... deep... est... apolo...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうし……
わ……け……
ご……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
W... wait!
Hrmmm... This can only... mean one thing, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっちょっと！
……むむむ、
これは……
そういうことだよね。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
The mystery man's goal is... the Twilight City.
But then why would he be handing out spellbooks...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
謎の男が探してるのは……
黄昏の都。
それならなんで魔導書を配り歩いたりなんか……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, it's just mysteries upon mysteries!
text_block_list.orig_text: ううう謎は深まるばかりだー！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
W-well, we managed to defeat his cronies,
so let's see what info they cough up after we throw them in jail!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、まあ弟子たちはこうして倒したわけだし、
牢屋に入れた後にでも色々聞き出そうじゃまいかー！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: More importantly... Thank you, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それよりも……
ありがとうね。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
That spell is fueled by the trust between its casters...
So you must have really trusted me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの魔法、
信頼関係がないと発動しないんだって……
君は、
私のことを信じてくれた……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Even after I got you hurt before...
choice_data_list: I believe in you with all my heart.
text_block_list.orig_text: 私のせいで怪我をしたのに……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
...Ehh?! That's, uh... R... right!
You just mean as an ally! Yeah, that's it! No deeper meanings!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……へっ！？
　
いやちょ……
あ、
うん！
相棒としてだよねきっと！　
うんそうだ！　
異論は認めない！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
B-but... when you come out and say it like that...
I-it's kind of embarrassing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、でも、
そんな面と向かって言われると……
は、
恥ずかしいでござるよ～！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Waaghh... I feel all hot!
Why's that?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うあ～
なんか熱い！
なんで！？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Oh... right, the volcano! My face is hot from the lava!
That's it. That's gotta be it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
そっか火山！　
火山だから顔が熱いんだ！
そうだ、
そうに違いない！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
An incredible new spell, and the mystery man's goal...
Having gained many things from this encounter, the magical girl duo
headed back to the city, their bonds stronger than ever.
text_block_list.orig_text:
新たな魔法の習得、そして謎の男の目的。
いくつかの収獲を得て、二人の絆はより強いものになっていた。
二人で一人の魔法少女として、街へと戻っていくのだった。
